brand.name: HongJun
brand.description: HongJun specializes in vacuum encapsulation (potting) machines for the new energy vehicle, electronics and industrial sensor sectors. With 15+ years of R&D and manufacturing experience, we deliver precision (0.01ml), reliability and customized solutions to global clients.

products.shortDesc: Fully automatic vacuum potting system for NEV pressure sensors and electronics. ±0.03mm precision, 0.01ml dispensing accuracy.
